title: Optimize isolated fragments
action: Perform geometry optimization of isolated fragments: C20, BC19, SiC19, and 1-acetylpiperazine at the M06-2X/6-31G(d) level of theory in gas phase and in water using the PCM solvation model. Verify no imaginary vibrational frequencies. Record optimized geometries and total electronic energies.
description: Optimized structures and energies of the fragments needed for complex building and binding energy calculations.

title: Optimize complexes
action: Build starting geometries for the six complexes: C20+1-ap (C=O), C20+1-ap (NH), BC19+1-ap (C=O), BC19+1-ap (NH), SiC19+1-ap (C=O), SiC19+1-ap (NH). For doped fullerenes the primary interaction site is the dopant atom. Perform geometry optimization at M06-2X/6-31G(d) in gas and water, verifying no imaginary frequencies. Record optimized geometries.
description: Optimized complex geometries required for subsequent property calculations.

title: Calculate BSSE-corrected binding energies and extract key interatomic distances
action: Using the optimized fragment and complex geometries, perform counterpoise (Boys-Bernardi) BSSE-corrected single-point energy calculations at M06-2X/6-31G(d) level for each complex in gas and water. Compute the binding energy Eb = E_complex - (E_fragment1_in_complex_basis + E_fragment2_in_complex_basis). Report results in kcal/mol. Additionally, from the optimized complex geometries of the doped-fullerene complexes, extract the key interatomic distances: Si...O for SiC19+1-ap (C=O), Si...N for SiC19+1-ap (NH), B...O for BC19+1-ap (C=O), and B...N for BC19+1-ap (NH), in both gas and water. Include these distances (in Å) as extra columns in the same CSV file; leave blank for undoped C20 complexes.
description: BSSE-corrected binding energies and key interatomic distances for all complexes.
output_schema: CSV with columns: complex (string), medium (gas/water), Eb_kcal_per_mol (float), Si_O_angstrom (float, optional), Si_N_angstrom (float, optional), B_O_angstrom (float, optional), B_N_angstrom (float, optional). 12 rows. The distance columns contain values only for the respective doped complexes; empty for others.

title: Extract electronic properties
action: From the optimized complex wavefunctions, extract HOMO and LUMO energies in eV. Compute energy gap Egap = ELUMO - EHOMO, chemical hardness eta = Egap/2, and electrophilicity index omega = mu^2/(2*eta) where mu = (EHOMO+ELUMO)/2. Report results for each complex in gas and water.
description: Frontier orbital energies and derived reactivity indices for each complex.
output_schema: CSV with columns: complex (string), medium (gas/water), EHOMO_eV (float), ELUMO_eV (float), Egap_eV (float), eta_eV (float), omega_eV (float). 12 rows.
